in_marathi.name: Yogender
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Discipline, Union with God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yogender हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yogender is a name of Sanskrit and Hindi origin meaning 'Discipline, Union with God'. It is derived from the roots 'yuj' meaning 'to unite or join' and 'andh' meaning 'male'. The name signifies a person who is deeply committed to the spiritual path and strives to attain union with the divine.

It is believed that this name was given to those who were skilled in yoga and possessed the divine power to control their minds and bodies. In Hindu mythology, Yogender is associated with Lord Shiva, the god of yoga and meditation.
